verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Q-W poke or walk into Infernal Chains range before level 6; you win if you dodge his engage with Valor and burst him with Ki Burst's stun once Infernal Chains and Umbral Dash are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains) reaches 825 range, more than double Riven's Q (Broken Wings, 275) or E (Valor, 250), so he can threaten and punish approaches long before Riven is close enough to answer. The 48.1% win rate over 1016 games reflects a lane where Riven has to play around that chain and his Deathbringer Stance sustain rather than dictate it, but her W (Ki Burst) stun still wins any fight where his E and W are both down.

theirWindow.when: Q and W (Infernal Chains) both up
theirWindow.what: He can poke with The Darkin Blade or land Infernal Chains on you from a range neither Broken Wings nor Valor can match; hold position and don't step up on his side of the wave.

yourWindow.when: W (Infernal Chains) and E (Umbral Dash) down
yourWindow.what: Close with Q (Broken Wings), land W (Ki Burst) for the stun, then auto through your Runic Blade charges; he has no chain or dash left to punish the commit.

start.why: Sustains you through his early Q/W poke so you aren't forced off the wave before level 3.

boots.why: Shortens the Q-W-E loop so Ki Burst's stun and Valor's block come back faster than his Infernal Chains cooldown.

core.why: Cooldown reduction feeds the same Q/W/E loop and shortens Blade of the Exile's reset window.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended auto-trades Riven wants into a melee bruiser, and the adaptive force/healing it grants outlasts his Q poke.

summoners.why: Ignite's true damage cuts through Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing and secures kills his sustain would otherwise deny.

playing.title: Don't contest levels 1-2
playing.detail: His Q (The Darkin Blade, 14s cooldown at rank 1) lands before your full combo exists; play for farm until you have Q and W by level 3.

playing.title: Hold E for his Q or W
playing.detail: Valor blocks incoming damage; save it to negate a Darkin Blade swing or an Infernal Chains hit instead of burning it just to close distance.

playing.title: Track Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: His passive empowers his next auto with bonus magic damage and a heal off your max health; back off from trades when it's lit up.

playing.title: All-in only when E and W are down
playing.detail: Umbral Dash heals him on hit and Infernal Chains can drag you back into him; confirm both are on cooldown before committing your Q-W burst.

playing.title: Use Q's third hit to disengage
playing.detail: The third Broken Wings strike knocks back nearby enemies; use it to create separation if he's chasing with Umbral Dash.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling against his sustain
playing.detail: Antiheal cuts both Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash's healing, matching the OP.GG read to burst him when his skills are down.

playing.title: Pair R with your stun, not before it
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's Wind Slash only needs to connect once; pop it during your Ki Burst stun since he can't interrupt it out of a stun.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 48.1% head-to-head win rate over 1016 games are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the lane-phase tactical reading is my own analysis of both kits.

stats.opponentTip: Manage your distance considering the range on Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo. After purchasing Executioner’s Calling, focus on dealing burst damage when Aatrox’s skills are on cooldown.
